title: No ticket for brand-manager team rollup reporting

nearest_ticket_quotes.summary: Brand Manager: Determine Object Model, Record Creation, and Sharing Controls
nearest_ticket_quotes.quote: BUILD-202 (BA-1, WAGR-176) already added a required Brand Manager lookup on the BA record — a BA without a Brand Manager is excluded from roll-up reporting — but the Brand Manager side of that relationship was never built out.

what_differs: The client's ideal state is easier brand-manager rollups (a team view of each brand manager's team), and Jumpr later said managers will get reporting on their teams. Jira has the Brand Manager object and visibility tickets (WAGR-391, WAGR-392) and WAGR-468 lists commission per manager, but no ticket for the team rollup reports.
suggested_action: Suggest a story under WAGR-24 for brand-manager team reports (metrics, data scope per L0889), dependent on WAGR-391.
